rows.text: with c = `rcx`, m = qword `+8` of c, p = qword `+0x20` of c and N(x) = `00861F14` of x's squared length, for i below signed word `+0x14` of c, id = word [signed word `+0x12` + i] of qword `+0x28` of m; signed ids from `0x5000` are skipped; a gate on dword x skips when bit 31 is set after the mask/value pair at `0209A2D0` + `0x110` + 8k (k = 32 + bits 13-17 of x) is merged into x; an id from `0x4000` takes the `0x90`-byte element e = id - `0x4000` of qword `+0x18` of m, gates its dword `+4`, fills v by `00381D90(e, &v, p)`, skips unless L = N(v through the 3x3 at qword `+0x18` of c) exceeds r = `003810B0(e, p)`, and scales v by d = L - r; a lower signed id takes the 32-byte element e of qword `+0x10` of m, gates its dword `+0xC` only when its low 3 bits are 1, sets v to its four floats and L likewise, and needs s = (p minus 16-byte vertex [signed word e`+0x10`] of qword `+8` of m) dot v in (-0.001, L), the call at `0022DE60` + 0x35E (m, id, p, &w) non-zero and q = N(w) below L, taking v = w, s = q when q exceeds s; v is scaled by d = L - s over N(v); a d above float `+0x30` of c is stored there with id at word `+0x34`, and v is added to the three floats at qword `+0x28` of c
